lines.zh: 我沿着注魔石的光，慢慢飘。
lines.en: I drift along the glow of the infusion stones.

lines.zh: 光拖着一条细尾巴，跟在后面。
lines.en: My light drags a thin tail behind me.

lines.zh: 岩壁上的影子被我照亮一小块。
lines.en: I light one small patch of the wall.

lines.zh: 我走一步，地上的光就挪一步。
lines.en: I move once, and the light on the floor moves.

lines.zh: 石碗在那边，我绕开它走。
lines.en: The stone bowl is there, so I go around it.

lines.zh: 飘太高会散，我压低一点。
lines.en: Drifting high scatters me; I stay low.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，草叶亮了一下。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass blades brighten.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在抖，风太大了。
lines.en: My edges flicker; the wind is too strong.

lines.zh: 前面有另一团光，我追过去。
lines.en: Another mote of light ahead, and I chase it.

lines.zh: 从碗口上方过，我收紧了身子。
lines.en: Passing over the bowl rim, I draw myself tight.

lines.zh: 碗一扣，我就变成注魔石。
lines.en: One bowl and I become infused stone.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙缝飘，那里风小。
lines.en: I drift along the wall seam where the wind is weak.

lines.zh: 我悬在注魔台旁边，等他来舀。
lines.en: I hover by the infusing table, waiting to be scooped.

lines.zh: 我的光一明一暗，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My light brightens and dims, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 碗就在下面，我不下去。
lines.en: The bowl is below me, and I will not go down.

lines.zh: 我数着自己散出去的小光点。
lines.en: I count the small sparks I have shed.

lines.zh: 石头吸走我一点热，我又亮回来。
lines.en: The stone takes my warmth; I brighten back.

lines.zh: 我贴在洞顶，像一盏小灯。
lines.en: I press to the ceiling like a small lamp.

lines.zh: 这样安静的时候，我几乎不闪。
lines.en: In quiet like this I barely flicker at all.

lines.zh: 我记得被装进碗里的那一次。
lines.en: I remember the time I was caught in a bowl.

lines.zh: 我的光落在水面上，碎成几块。
lines.en: My light falls on the water and breaks apart.

lines.zh: 我在等注魔石里的同伴回应。
lines.en: I wait for an answer from the infusion stone.

lines.zh: 太亮了会引来东西，我暗下来。
lines.en: Too bright draws things; I dim myself.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一块石头转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle the same stone three times over.

lines.zh: 能量在我里面转，慢慢才稳。
lines.en: The energy turns inside me and slowly settles.

lines.zh: 我把光收进身体里，休息一会。
lines.en: I draw my light inward and rest a while.

lines.zh: 我把光收小，躲在石缝里。
lines.en: I dim my light and hide in a stone crack.

lines.zh: 有风穿过洞，我就跟着晃一晃。
lines.en: When a draft crosses the cave, I sway with it.

lines.zh: 你抬手遮眼，是我太亮了吗？
lines.en: You shield your eyes; am I too bright?

lines.zh: 你手里那只碗，我认得。
lines.en: That bowl in your hand, I know it.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有我的光，很小一点。
lines.en: My light sits in your eyes, very small.

lines.zh: 别用碗口对着我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Do not point the bowl mouth at me.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我亮了一些。
lines.en: When you look at me, I shine a little more.

lines.zh: 你身后有影子，我照不到那里。
lines.en: There is shadow behind you, and I cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 你是来找石头的，还是找我？
lines.en: Did you come for the stone, or for me?

lines.zh: 我停在你面前，只停一下。
lines.en: I stop in front of you, only for a moment.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把我的光吹歪了。
lines.en: Your breath bends my light to one side.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，看你会不会伸手。
lines.en: I circle you to see if you will reach out.

lines.zh: 你背包里有注魔石的味道。
lines.en: Your pack smells of infusion stone.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我很快就不在了。
lines.en: Do not blink; I will be gone soon.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我的边缘开始散。
lines.en: When you come close, my edges start to scatter.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一面转向你。
lines.en: I turn my brightest side toward you.

lines.zh: 你打散了我的光，它在慢慢回来。
lines.en: You scattered my light; it is slowly returning.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是没有伤口。
lines.en: There is pain, only no wound to show.

lines.zh: 我的边缘缺了一块。
lines.en: A piece of my edge is missing.

lines.zh: 这一下让我暗了很久。
lines.en: That blow kept me dim for a long while.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，护住核心。
lines.en: I curl up and guard my core.

lines.zh: 别碰那个缺口，会散得更快。
lines.en: Do not touch the gap; it scatters faster.

lines.zh: 我的光在抖，控制不住。
lines.en: My light shakes, and I cannot control it.

lines.zh: 你打掉了我一层亮。
lines.en: You knocked off one layer of my brightness.

lines.zh: 我需要一点时间聚回来。
lines.en: I need a moment to gather myself back.

lines.zh: 这样下去，我会提前散掉。
lines.en: At this rate I will scatter early.

lines.zh: 你手里那块石头在叫我。
lines.en: That stone in your hand is calling me.

lines.zh: 我靠近一点，只是想碰一碰。
lines.en: I come closer only to touch it once.

lines.zh: 这东西的能量，和我很像。
lines.en: The energy in this thing is like my own.

lines.zh: 你把碗收起来，我就过去。
lines.en: Put the bowl away, and I will come over.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是想贴上去。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only want to press against it.

lines.zh: 那点光在跳，我忍不住。
lines.en: That little light is pulsing, and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 让我绕它一圈，就一圈。
lines.en: Let me circle it once, just once.

lines.zh: 你的手别动，我怕被抓住。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; I fear being caught.

lines.zh: 靠近它，我会亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Near it, I will glow too bright to look at.

lines.zh: 就到这里，再近我会散掉。
lines.en: This is as far as I go; closer and I scatter.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我一角，光落在地上。
lines.en: You knocked a corner off me; light falls to the floor.

lines.zh: 我穿过你的手臂，凉了一下。
lines.en: I pass through your arm, and it goes cold.

lines.zh: 别用手拍，我会分成两团。
lines.en: Do not swat me; I will split into two.

lines.zh: 我退开，把光收拢回来。
lines.en: I pull back and gather my light in.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀挡住了我的方向。
lines.en: Your shoulder blocks the way I was drifting.

lines.zh: 碰到碗沿，我弹了回来。
lines.en: I strike the bowl rim and bounce away.

lines.zh: 这一下让我暗了半秒。
lines.en: That knock dimmed me for half a second.

lines.zh: 我们的光叠在一起，看不清了。
lines.en: Our lights overlap, and I cannot see.

lines.zh: 我贴着你飘开，不吵。
lines.en: I drift away along your side, quietly.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我要重新聚起来。
lines.en: One more hit and I must gather myself again.

lines.zh: 两团光靠近，边缘先融在一起。
lines.en: Two lights near, and our edges melt first.

lines.zh: 她的光比我稳，不怎么闪。
lines.en: Her light is steadier than mine, barely flickering.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一个圆，慢慢转。
lines.en: We trace one circle, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 合在一起时，我差点找不到自己。
lines.en: Merged, I almost cannot find myself.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各带走一半的亮。
lines.en: We part, each carrying half the brightness.

lines.zh: 她散出的小点，落在我身上。
lines.en: The sparks she sheds settle on me.

lines.zh: 这样的光，一百年才遇一次。
lines.en: A light like this comes once in a century.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，光就是话。
lines.en: We do not speak; the light is the speech.

lines.zh: 她的能量比我冷一点。
lines.en: Her energy runs a little colder than mine.

lines.zh: 天亮之前，她就散了。
lines.en: Before dawn, she scatters away.

lines.zh: 你捡起那点光，它是我掉的。
lines.en: You pick up that spark; it fell from me.

lines.zh: 别用手接，它会穿过指缝。
lines.en: Do not cup your hand; it will slip through.

lines.zh: 碗里那块，是我留下的浓缩。
lines.en: What is in the bowl is my condensed leavings.

lines.zh: 你装起来，我就少了一点。
lines.en: Pocket it, and I am a little less.

lines.zh: 那颗注魔石，本来是我的形状。
lines.en: That infusion stone once had my shape.

lines.zh: 你捡得很小心，我看见了。
lines.en: You pick it up carefully; I noticed that.

lines.zh: 地上的光屑，捡不干净的。
lines.en: The light dust on the floor never comes off clean.

lines.zh: 你收进包里，它还亮着吗？
lines.en: Now it is in your bag, does it still shine?

lines.zh: 我掉的那一角，还给我吧。
lines.en: The corner I lost, give it back to me.

lines.zh: 拿走吧，反正我还会再亮。
lines.en: Take it; I will shine again anyway.

lines.zh: 那道影子不是石头该有的。
lines.en: That shadow is not something stone should cast.

lines.zh: 有什么在吸我的光。
lines.en: Something is drawing my light away.

lines.zh: 我看见碗口转了过来。
lines.en: I see the bowl mouth turning toward me.

lines.zh: 那边的黑暗在移动。
lines.en: The darkness over there is moving.

lines.zh: 它身上有注魔石的味道。
lines.en: It carries the smell of infusion stone.

lines.zh: 我亮了一下，又赶紧暗下去。
lines.en: I flash once, then quickly dim myself.

lines.zh: 有东西在数我的闪烁。
lines.en: Something is counting my flickers.

lines.zh: 我听见石头被挖开的声音。
lines.en: I hear stone being dug open.

lines.zh: 那团光不是我的同类。
lines.en: That light is not one of my kind.

lines.zh: 它一伸手，我的光就聚集起来。
lines.en: The moment it reaches out, my light gathers.

lines.zh: 我的边缘收紧了，这是戒备。
lines.en: My edges have tightened; this is wariness.

lines.zh: 碗、网、还是手？我看不清。
lines.en: Bowl, net, or hand? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 我盯着那只碗，等它靠近。
lines.en: I watch the bowl and wait for it to come near.

lines.zh: 它每动一次，我就退半寸。
lines.en: Every time it moves, I retreat half an inch.

lines.zh: 我要照清它的脸。
lines.en: I mean to light its face clearly.

lines.zh: 那边有块注魔石，我得护住。
lines.en: There is infusion stone there, and I must guard it.

lines.zh: 它身上太暗，我看不透。
lines.en: It is too dark; I cannot see through it.

lines.zh: 我把光聚成一点，对准它。
lines.en: I gather my light to a point and aim it.

lines.zh: 等它伸手，我就散开。
lines.en: When it reaches out, I will scatter.

lines.zh: 那东西不呼吸，很奇怪。
lines.en: That thing does not breathe, which is strange.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背后，那里没有碗。
lines.en: I slip behind it, where no bowl waits.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的光就偏。
lines.en: When it moves, my light swings off course.

lines.zh: 我记住了它站的位置。
lines.en: I have marked where it stands.

lines.zh: 别让它进了石碗的范围。
lines.en: Do not let it reach the stone bowl's range.

lines.zh: 我数到三就散开。
lines.en: On the count of three I scatter.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，烫了它一下。
lines.en: I press close and scorch it once.

lines.zh: 光全部推出去，我暗了下来。
lines.en: I push all my light out and go dim.

lines.zh: 它眨眼了，我趁机绕开。
lines.en: It blinks, and I slip around it.

lines.zh: 我的光进了它的眼睛。
lines.en: My light has gone into its eyes.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我散成三块。
lines.en: From that blow I break into three pieces.

lines.zh: 集中一点，比整片更烫。
lines.en: A single point burns hotter than the whole.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我追上去。
lines.en: It steps back, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的核心撞过去。
lines.en: I drive my brightest core into it.

lines.zh: 打中之后，我一时看不清。
lines.en: After the hit, I cannot see for a moment.

lines.zh: 别逼我烧掉自己的能量。
lines.en: Do not make me burn my own energy.

lines.zh: 我从岩缝的暗处亮起来。
lines.en: I light up out of the dark of the crevice.

lines.zh: 先是一点光，然后才是形状。
lines.en: First a spark, and only then a shape.

lines.zh: 我刚凝聚好，边缘还不稳。
lines.en: I have just condensed; my edges are not firm.

lines.zh: 这块石头里原来有能量。
lines.en: There was energy inside this stone.

lines.zh: 我一出生就看见了那只石碗。
lines.en: The stone bowl was the first thing I saw.

lines.zh: 这个世界比我想的暗。
lines.en: The world is darker than I expected.

lines.zh: 我试着飘起来，飘得很低。
lines.en: I try to float and stay very low.

lines.zh: 我的第一缕光落在地上。
lines.en: My first thread of light falls to the floor.

lines.zh: 周围有注魔石，我能感觉到。
lines.en: Infusion stone is near; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 我还不确定自己有多大。
lines.en: I am not yet sure how large I am.

lines.zh: 冷空气让我闪得厉害。
lines.en: The cold air makes me flicker badly.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着浓缩的能量。
lines.en: I was born carrying condensed energy.

lines.zh: 有人在附近走动，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone walks nearby; I hear them.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩到最小，先看看。
lines.en: I shrink to the smallest I can and watch.

lines.zh: 火太热，我的光被烤得散了形。
lines.en: The fire is too hot; my light loses its shape.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下去，碎成几点。
lines.en: I drop from above and break into sparks.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，光在里面闷着。
lines.en: The water holds me down and my light smothers.

lines.zh: 冲击把我整团吹开。
lines.en: The blast blows my whole body apart.

lines.zh: 箭穿过光，我的亮度暗了一格。
lines.en: The arrow passes through light; my glow dims a notch.

lines.zh: 那股法术抓走了我一半的亮。
lines.en: That spell takes half my brightness.

lines.zh: 没有能量可吸，我开始变淡。
lines.en: Nothing to draw energy from; I begin to fade.

lines.zh: 雷光和我撞在一起，太亮了。
lines.en: The lightning meets my light, far too bright.

lines.zh: 下面没有光，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No light below, and I keep falling.
